title: TerrainJob
description: A solution-independent job statement — what a performer is trying to accomplish. Based on JTBD principles. Must be solvable by at least 5 different technologies or business models (solution-neutral test §21).

statement.description: Solution-neutral job statement. Format: verb + object + context. Example: 'Reconcile chargeable warehouse activity before issuing a customer invoice.' NOT: 'Use software to reconcile warehouse activity.'

jobType.description: FUNCTIONAL = the work to accomplish. EMOTIONAL/SOCIAL = only where evidence supports.

contexts.description: Circumstances where this job is performed. e.g. 'month-end close', 'post-retrofit settlement'.

triggers.description: What initiates this job. e.g. 'customer places order', 'audit date approaches', 'flexibility event called'.

desiredOutcomes.description: What does done look like? Solution-neutral metric-style statements. e.g. 'Minimize time to verify all mandatory evidence is collected before submission.'

evidence.description: Evidence that this job is real. Every item must have an epistemic label.
